gen-gf-phudu-gf-electrolize: Marker-bold and wide-mouthed, Phudu grabs the eye first. Electrolize follows with a modern, open-jawed c, and next to Phudu's loud marker line the two feel like a shout and a crisp reply.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-encode-sans-expanded: Encode Sans Expanded pulls the tips of its c wide apart, friendly and wide-stanced. Encode Sans Expanded would carry paragraph after paragraph without tiring, while Phudu's pipe-cleaner strokes handle the loud part.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-encode-sans-sc: Phudu draws bold letters with no calligraphic thinning at all. Encode Sans SC handles the quieter work, with shallow terminal curls and wide gaps, while Phudu is best at making a loud first impression.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-exo: Crisp down to tiny sizes thanks to its wide gaps, Exo reads clean and approachable. Exo keeps that friendliness going through long paragraphs, while Phudu's hairline-free, swell-free letters stay bold up top.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-faculty-glyphic: Phudu looks like glass tubing bent into letters, bold and a little strange. And Faculty Glyphic reads modern and clear, its rounded letters leaving generous openings that make long text easy going.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-fahkwang: Fahkwang reads approachable and contemporary, with a faint nib-pressure shift across each round letter. But Phudu is a stripe of constant ink, so shrinking it much would waste its bold, open curves.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-fustat: Phudu is bold and distinctive, its curves finishing with generous openings. Fustat, drawn like bent tubing with a clear gap where the c ends, gives long reading a modern, steady footing.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-google-sans: Phudu is all bold, ballpoint-plain line weight. Google Sans pulls its terminals well back and drops the thick-thin shift, so beside Phudu's loud display letters it feels approachable and contemporary.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-gudea: A ballpoint's pressure-free line gives Phudu its bold, distinctive look. And Gudea, with glass-clear gaps and thread-thin curves, is best left to the body, with Phudu reserved for big display lines.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-hanken-grotesk: Phudu is made for a bold, distinctive first look, with ballpoint-plain strokes and open curve ends. Hanken Grotesk does the quieter job, its wire-bent letters and wide channels into each counter keeping body text clean and modern.
